text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to gather ideas for <chrname>'s training, I 
came to observe how other Umamusume were 
practicing, when...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ――Ah, Ramonu-senpai is going to run……!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ――Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume and Trainer on the track 
stopped in their tracks, utterly 
mesmerized by her run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A stride of flawless, powerful beauty. The 
moment she burst into a sprint, it was as 
if time itself had frozen――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —It stopped, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking my inner thoughts had slipped out 
loud, I gasped. She looked back at me with 
an unreadable gaze.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very well, I shall hear you out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Stagnation…… I despise growing weary of 
things. I need stimulation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
How would you guide your beloved child, I 
wonder?
choice_data_list:
(I have no idea what she's getting at with 
that question...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list:
(No way the mood lets me ask for 
clarification now!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A beloved child... Do you mean a trainee 
Uma Musume? If she's in a slump... 
struggling to make progress, and I had to 
offer advice――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In racing, speed is an exceedingly vital 
factor. In the end, pursuing pure velocity 
can sometimes be the quickest 
breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmph……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're quite forceful, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes, speed is something that must be 
continuously honed. Because...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Because it's the most primitive form of 
love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By trimming down those little time losses, 
you can shave down your final time. 
Cornering is a vital skill.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fine to me. Once you reach that 
level, it definitely makes all the 
difference.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, why?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Every last one of them—bows their heads.
